newDescription: In this L3 11+ Maths lesson, students learn how to calculate and interpret the mean, median, mode and range. They practise finding the mean by adding values and dividing by the number of values, rounding where needed, solving word problems involving money, time and experimental data, and working backwards from a known mean to find a missing value. They then order numbers and decimals to find the median for odd and even-sized data sets, identify modes in numerical and categorical data including multiple modes or no mode, use frequency tables to find modal values, and calculate the range including with negative numbers. The final section combines all four measures in multi-step problems involving test scores, temperatures, heights, prices and trends, requiring students to choose the appropriate statistic and justify their calculations.
